name: Velex HydroFrame Reinforced Denim
description: Heavy dark-indigo denim jeans with triple-stitched inner seams and a flexible aramid-weave lining along the inner thigh and calf — built to handle the micro-vibration and joint pressure of hydraulic leg augments without shredding at the seams after a month of use. The cut is a standard relaxed straight leg with a slightly higher rise. They look like good jeans. They last.
functionality: Inner seam reinforcement rated for sustained hydraulic joint pressure and vibration. Resists seam failure at pressure points common to hydraulic aug limbs.
what_it_says: You've burned through regular jeans with your chrome and learned from it.
worn_by: anyone who's ruined too many pairs of normal denim
story_hooks: The aramid lining is the same material used in budget ballistic gear — someone's wearing these for a reason beyond chrome compatibility.
A Tier 2 mechanic's been patching and re-patching a pair of these for three years; the patches tell a story of where she's been.

physical_description.visual_profile: Classic straight-leg silhouette with a working-class authenticity. The deep indigo denim reads as premium-adjacent but functionally built—no flash, no chrome trim. Higher rise sits comfortably above the hip, suggesting practical wear rather than fashion statement. Substantial weight to the fabric creates a confident drape.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed straight leg through hip and thigh with a natural taper at the ankle. Higher rise (approximately 11-12 inches) accommodates augmented legs without binding. Cut wide enough to layer protective gear underneath without visible bunching.
physical_description.primary_material: Heavy-weight raw indigo denim with aramid-weave reinforcement lining along inner thigh and calf. Synthetic-aramid blend rated for repetitive joint stress and micro-vibration absorption.
physical_description.texture: Crisp, densely-woven denim with visible slub texture. The aramid liner creates subtle ridging along inner seams—tactilely rough to touch but engineered for durability. Fabric resists pilling and shows deliberate wear patterns rather than random degradation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo (#1C3A47 range) with natural fading patterns along stress points. Contrast stitching in cream or off-white on visible seams. Minimal branding—small woven label at waistband only.
physical_description.closures: Traditional five-button fly with reinforced button anchors. Waistband has friction-fit adjustment and a discrete utility loop on left hip for tool attachment.
distinctive_features: Triple-stitched inner seams for maximum durability under hydraulic pressure
Aramid-weave reinforcement panel running full inner leg
Stress-point bar-tacking at all major seams and pockets
Hidden utility loop on left hip (tool attachment point)
Crotch gusset in reinforced composite weave
Deep thigh pocket geometry optimized for augment-mounted sensor access
No visible tech ports or mag-snap integration—fully mechanical closures
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional—built for working-class augmented laborers. Not luxury, not salvage. Purpose-engineered durability signals skilled trades, industrial work, or private security.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is someone whose body modifications are work-critical, not aspirational. Worn by hydraulic rig operators, construction workers, enforcers, and anyone whose legs bear literal mechanical load. No posturing—these are pants for people who need their gear to survive their job.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but not destroyed. Expected to show stress-wear along inner thighs and knee areas after 6-12 months. Indigo fades deliberately along flex points. Occasional grease stains or small tears near pockets are professional markers, not flaws. A well-maintained pair shows character through use, not damage.
